stories.title: “I am absolutely appalled”: councillors lose fight against Flint HMO plan
stories.summary: Plans to turn a former council house in Flint into a four-person HMO for residents at risk of homelessness have been approved despite local objections. County Councillors Ian Roberts and Cllr Paul Cunningham spoke out against the proposals during a Flintshire Planning Committee meeting. stories.title: Man, 20, arrested after Mold Town Council offices damaged

stories.title: Flintshire County Council to review scrutiny function after watchdogs raise concerns
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is to review how its scrutiny committees work, after three separate watchdogs found the process is not working well enough.
